book: Tomus primus of Bartholomaeus Keckermann's Systematis systematum (1613), a Latin volume of seven works on logic and rhetoric (Præcognita logica, Systema logicum maius, Gymnasium logicum, Systema logicum minus, Systema rhetoricum, Introductio ad eloquentiam, Rhetorica ecclesiastica), each built from books or tractatus, sections and numbered chapters; the sheet's headings cover only the first three works and the front matter, and the remaining works have no headings on the sheet.
